name: Beef Short Ribs
siboNotes: Naturally FODMAP-free protein that's well-tolerated. Choose lean cuts and avoid high-FODMAP marinades or sauces during preparation.
preparationTips: Braise with low-FODMAP vegetables like carrots and celery
Use garlic-infused oil instead of whole garlic for flavor
Season with fresh herbs like thyme, rosemary, or bay leaves
Trim visible fat before cooking to aid digestion
